about: L017 records the decision to start amitriptyline as the first antidepressant for this episode of major depression. L018 is its first supply.
Possible finding: Dothep 75 (dosulepin) first appears at L016. The record gives no indication and does not establish whether this was the first treatment for an episode of major depression.
The June amitriptyline course was for nerve pain, and L023 records its later use for major depression after sertraline.
